• A scenario description taken from an excerpt of JPMorgan Chase & Co.’s 2008 Annual Report (the data table that accompanies the excerpt has been withheld).
• A set of callable tools that let you query a synthetic database derived from that report and perform simple calculations.
• The question you must answer.

Scenario description
--------------------
JPMorgan Chase & Co.’s Annual Report discusses several kinds of collateralised financing transactions.  Among them are “securities borrowed”, “securities loaned”, “securities purchased under resale agreements”, and “securities sold under repurchase agreements”.  The firm monitors the market value of securities borrowed and lent on a daily basis, calling for additional collateral when appropriate.  Fees received or paid in connection with these transactions are recorded in interest income or expense.  The report then provides a detailed table that breaks out the dollar amounts for each of these categories by year (for example, 2008 and 2007).  Additional narrative explains valuation practices, the treatment of pledged securities, and accounting policies for loans, but the exact numeric amounts from the table are not reproduced here.

Available tools
---------------
find_categories_containing(keyword)
  Return a list of financing category names whose text contains the given keyword (case-insensitive).

list_all_categories()
  List every financing category present in the database.

list_categories_for_year(year)
  List the financing categories that have annual records for the specified year.

get_category_grouping(category_name)
  Return the high-level grouping label (e.g. “collateralized_financing”) associated with a category.

get_financing_amount(year, category_name)
  Fetch the annual amount (in USD millions) for the given category in the given year.

get_quarterly_financing_amount(year, quarter, category_name)
  Fetch the quarterly amount (in USD millions) for the given category/year/quarter.

get_macro_indicator(year, indicator_name)
  Retrieve a macro-economic indicator value for the specified year (not directly related to the financing table).

compute_ratio(numerator, denominator, decimal_places=1)
  Compute numerator ÷ denominator, rounded to the specified number of decimal places.

Question
--------
What was the ratio of the securities borrowed to the securities loaned in 2008?

Instructions
------------
Use the tools as needed to discover the relevant category names, retrieve the 2008 dollar amounts (in millions) for “securities borrowed” and “securities loaned”, and then compute the ratio (borrowed ÷ loaned) rounded to one decimal place.  Your final reply must be the numeric ratio only, with no additional commentary.
